allocation: capped proportional Hamilton allocation with minimum one selected record in every positive supported cell; fixed MD5 order

arms.A: old C1 explicit generative-AI use arm, nested in accepted 40,300 sample
arms.B: old C1 explicit traditional-software use with no detected AI, nested in accepted 40,300 sample
arms.C: Residual within explicitly technology-screened candidate frame, not occupation-wide background

frame: usable ads in the original 69 OCCUPATION_MAJOR x CENSUS_REGION x CREATED-year support cells, 2018-01-01 through 2026-06-30
privacy: row-level keys and any later ad text remain private and excluded from Git
probabilities: total_inclusion_probability = original_inclusion_probability * conditional_inclusion_probability; nested_design_weight is its inverse
raw_vs_weighted: raw sample counts must not be presented as weighted estimates
standardization: pooled_cell_standardization_weight is the original pooled A+B frame W_h and is stored separately from design weights
source_lineage_limitation: C is a residual within a prefiltered technology-candidate frame: any explicit GenAI use/develop or traditional-software use/develop (build_comparison_join.py line96). It does not cover all other advertisements in those occupations or ads screened out by the original technology rules. The proposed broad-background C target remains unmet; retain these2000 as a separate restricted diagnostic, without redraw.
upstream_filter: tech_generative_ai_use_explicit OR tech_generative_ai_develop_explicit OR tech_traditional_software_use_explicit OR tech_traditional_software_develop_explicit
